rows.name: FreeNAS 11.3 with a seven-disk ZFS RAIDZ1 pool
rows.source_text: Best documented match for scheduled integrity checks and redundant-data correction, conditional on accepting RAIDZ1 and a separate storage OS. RAIDZ1 is a proposed single-parity substitute; literal RAID5 equivalence was not established as acceptable.; Physical disk presentation and integration with the existing ESXi/Windows deployment are unknown; official 11.3-U3 guidance discourages production virtualization.; Pool creation requires moving existing data elsewhere first.

rows.name: Purelymail
rows.source_text: Lowest documented annual entry price among the investigated providers, with owned-domain hosting and portable IMAP mail. $10/year is subject to soft resource limits. Delivery performance, archive size fit and recurring export operation are untested. No mail API claim is made.
